g.text: Four of the five country lines are one number split four ways

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: What it shows: each non-China region as a percentage of the four combined, at every date the country tab plots. If these

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: were four measurements the shares would move. Across the 12 dates where the base is large enough for the site's 0.1T

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: rounding not to dominate, they move by at most 0.32 percentage points.

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Source: Tokens Per Day (tokensperday.com) — tokens_per_day_country.csv + geography_allocation_shares.csv — chartData objects and

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: evidence ledger as extracted 2026-08-21

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Methodology: Methodology reference pending final methodology document; derivation follows the Tokens Per Day published methodology and estimates pages

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Note: That is the finding: the United States, Europe, Asia ex-China and Rest of world are one number — non-China tokens — split 47/18/13/22

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: and never re-measured. The shares come from OpenRouter's billing-geography mix, a roughly 1% sample skewed to Western developers, and

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: the site rates them low confidence. Four of the five lines in TPD-02 therefore carry one line's shape, and a reader comparing Europe

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: against Asia is reading a constant. Rounding alone permits 0.27pp of the movement seen.
